contexts.text: Exactors () = those who want to compel them to serve. Illustrated.

The exactors in the people () = those who proximately infest. (For) exactors = those who compel to serve; and as this is effected by means of infestations, exactors also = those who infest, that is, those who proximately infest... For the exactors were from the Egyptians. AC 7136.
Whom the exactors of Pharaoh set over them () = those who are being injected by the infesters. Explained.
Exactors () = those who do violence to truths.
